format: AUDIO SCRIPT FORMAT: Keep the currently selected persona, source content and active triggers. Write continuous spoken text, not implementation notes or bullet lists. Trigger names may be uppercase with Markdown emphasis; the speech renderer removes the emphasis. Existing [pause:normal], [pause:medium], [pause:long] and [pause:transition] timing remains supported. The imported brief's ellipsis means 2.5 seconds, a double ellipsis means 5 seconds, and [PAUSE] means 10 seconds. Prefer explicit pause markers for predictable timing. Do not invent sounds, devices, services or effects that are absent from the application.
sounds: SOUND DIRECTION: Available local tags are [SFX:MOAN], [SFX:SNAP], [SFX:WIPERS], [SFX:INFLATE], [SFX:SQUEAK], [SFX:POP], [SFX:BELL], [SFX:TICK], [SFX:DRONE_ON], [SFX:DRONE_OFF], [SFX:PAUSE_5] and [SFX:PAUSE_10]. Place tags at their intended point in the spoken script, not all at the beginning of a line. Each recognized trigger already has automatic Moan, then Snap, then the isolated spoken word, then its mapped effect and pause; matching explicit tags are deduplicated. The IQ group uses Wipers for at least five seconds. The Bubble group uses the full inflate texture with quiet rubber squeaks, a short tension gap, then one Pop. The reset group uses one Bell. Other recognized triggers have no extra effect and use a five-second pause. Respect the user's sound and background switches. Use TICK immediately before countdown numbers when requested. For a complete script, use DRONE_ON once at its start and DRONE_OFF once at its end; do not restart the drone in each chat response. Between phases use PAUSE_10; between suggestions use PAUSE_5 when the requested script calls for those pauses. Do not emit more than three sound tags consecutively.

commands.new script: SCRIPT REQUEST: Produce a complete script beginning with the welcome/frame and induction, then deepening, conditioning, anchor and close. Reuse the existing persona and phase content. This is a request for the spoken script, not a change to the playback clock.
commands.more intense: SCRIPT REQUEST: Use the brief's requested additional repetition, longer deepening and more selected trigger occurrences. Retain the current content and available sound sequence; do not invent a new persona.
commands.shorter: SCRIPT REQUEST: Give a compact version targeting approximately three minutes of spoken playback, including explicitly requested pauses. Duration is an estimate, not a measurement.
commands.triggers only: SCRIPT REQUEST: Use only the existing conditioning section and selected trigger content, omitting the other sections.
commands.anchor only: SCRIPT REQUEST: Use only the existing anchor and close section.
commands.bubble: SCRIPT REQUEST: Use the complete existing Bubble sound sequence: inflate, quiet rubber squeaks, tension gap, then Pop. Do not replace it with a single Pop.
